title: Expert at Staying Right Here
style: Intimate electronic pop with a restrained mezzo-soprano lead, dry conversational verses over clipped synth pulses and a steady club kick; build the pre-chorus with rising arpeggios and close harmonies, then open into a catchy, bittersweet chorus with rounded trance bass, crisp drums, and subtle distorted-guitar accents. A brief spoken-feeling bridge should turn the joke inward before the final chorus; polished but human, with clear vocals and sly dynamic contrast.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I made a chart with color-coded reasons
For why I keep postponing what I know
Then made a second chart to track the first one
And missed the little box marked “start, just go”
I can explain the loop in six neat bullet points
Name every trigger, label every cue
My notes are excellent; my follow-through’s
A small, mysterious animal I can’t get to

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ve got the map, the route, the weather report
A fresh new plan with a sensible name
I’m standing at the door with my shoes on
Researching how to leave the same

[Chorus]
I know exactly what I ought to do
I’ve diagrammed the steps and color-coded two
I’ve built a tiny theory of escape
Then used it as a very clever way to wait
My mind says, “Look, we’ve solved it on the page”
My hands say, “Great—let’s do that… another day”
I’m not confused, I’m not unaware
I’m just an expert at staying right here

[Verse 2]
I bought a timer, then compared the timers
Read twelve reviews on focus, twice apiece
I found a method that could change my whole life
And spent the afternoon optimizing its settings
There’s a version of me giving a lecture
On how the habit loop can be undone
She’s very clear, persuasive, and convincing
She’s never once begun the thing she’s done

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ve got the why, the when, the clever workaround
A backup plan for when the plan feels hard
I keep inventing nicer-looking exits
And calling every detour a fresh start

[Chorus]
I know exactly what I ought to do
I’ve diagrammed the steps and color-coded two
I’ve built a tiny theory of escape
Then used it as a very clever way to wait
My mind says, “Look, we’ve solved it on the page”
My hands say, “Great—let’s do that… another day”
I’m not confused, I’m not unaware
I’m just an expert at staying right here

[Bridge]
No, being smart didn’t make the knot
It just taught me how to describe it
And every time I nearly pull it loose
I write a paper on the proper way to untie it

[Final Chorus]
I know exactly what I ought to do
I’ve diagrammed the steps and color-coded two
I’ve built a tiny theory of escape
Then used it as a very clever way to wait
My mind says, “Look, we’ve solved it on the page”
My hands say, “Great—let’s do that… another day”
I’m not confused, I’m not unaware
I’m just an expert at staying right here

[Outro]
Tomorrow has a checklist
Tomorrow has a name
Tomorrow’s got a framework
And tomorrow looks the same
